data.title: ArchivesSpace digital object linking to DSpace via REST API
data.description:
Bidirectional URI linking between ArchivesSpace digital objects and DSpace items
using REST APIs on both sides. Supports single-item linking (A1) and bulk
linking from a DSpace collection (A2) via repeated application of the same
link contract.
data.configuration_notes:
See specs/A2-dspace-bulk-linking.md for LinkMap JSON, DSpace Discovery search,
AS full-POST update pattern, and DSpace metadata PATCH.

data.title: CollectionSpace OAI-PMH metadata provider for discovery harvesters
data.description:
Expose CollectionSpace collection and object metadata via an OAI-PMH 2.0
provider so external discovery systems (VuFind, Blacklight, regional portals)
can harvest records. Does not move binaries; harvesters consume descriptive metadata.
data.prerequisites:
CollectionSpace with OAI-PMH provider configured; harvester supporting OAI-PMH 2.0
and desired metadata prefix (typically oai_dc).
data.configuration_notes:
See specs/C1-cs-oai-pmh.md for Identify, ListRecords, and admin configuration
paths. Target system is listed as Other because harvester choice varies by institution.

data.title: VIVO publication deposit to DSpace via SWORD v2
data.description:
Researcher-facing deposit workflow from VIVO publication records to a DSpace
institutional repository using SWORD v2 AtomPub. Covers service document
discovery, metadata package deposit, and optional link-back on the VIVO profile.
data.prerequisites:
DSpace with SWORD v2 enabled; VIVO with configured deposit target; shared or
per-researcher IR credentials per institution policy.
data.configuration_notes:
PoC targets DSpace SWORD v2 (not v3). See specs/V1-vivo-sword-deposit.md for
admin configuration, deposit HTTP sequence, and metadata mapping gaps.
